english.title: Conspire to supply a class A controlled drug - MDMA
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to supply

(E)_[**(..SPECIFY QUANTITY..)]_
(F)_[a quantity]_

of methylenedioxymethylamphetamine (Ecstasy), a controlled drug of class A
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(3)(a) of, and Schedule 4 to, the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order
Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See H2382 for the substantive "supply" offence.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H5071, H5072, H5073, H5075, H5076 and H5077 for conspiracy to supply in relation to class A drugs.

other.penalty:
Indictable: maximum life imprisonment and / or a fine.

A minimum sentence of seven years may apply to a third class A drug trafficking offence, see section 313 of the Sentencing Act 2020 and paragraph 1 of Schedule 2 to the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
